name: Greater Psionic Weapon [Psionic]
body:
You can charge your melee weapon with additional damage potential.

Prerequisite: Str 13, Psionic Weapon, base attack bonus +6.

Benefit: When you use the Psionic Weapon feat, your attack deals an extra 2 points of damage instead of 1 point of damage while you maintain psionic focus, and deal an extra 4d6 points of damage instead of an extra 2d6 points when you expend your psionic focus.
